title: Conditional Q3 onsite shifted-potential operator/source bridge
question: Under declared one-sided local graph bounds for q^m A^(-3/4), does the actual onsite Q3 shifted potential admit an exact source-weighted operator majorant?

scoped_verdict: Conditional on the declared one-sided graph bounds for local q powers, triangle inequality gives the exact onsite shifted-potential source majorant B_on(S). The fixture derives energy ratio 256, root scale 4, M=(1,4,16,64), B_on=10791/1024, and t*B_on=10791/8192.

Multiplying one-step majorants requires an A-power transport/product theorem and is not inferred from this triangle bound.
R225 checks rational coefficient and rate fixtures only; it does not formalize the operator hypothesis.
